reader_paraphrases.engineering_editor: The benchmark gives engineers a fixed test for severe felt-intensity classifiers and a transparent logistic reference that added model complexity must improve on.
reader_paraphrases.methods_reviewer: All four learned models beat constant prevalence, depth improves on magnitude alone, and logistic regression and XGBoost both round to Brier 0.181 while their paired comparison remains unresolved.
reader_paraphrases.intelligent_non_specialist: The study checks earthquake classifiers under fair rules, finds that depth helps, and shows that a simple model performs competitively with XGBoost without claiming a winner.
